--- title: "Inhibition" subtitle: "Automatically generated task sheet · F_EJEC_INH_INHIBICION" --- ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} **Automatically generated task sheet** (E · Decision with response time; quality class A). Generated on November 27, 2026 with `scripts/R/ficha_generica_v3.R --tarea F_EJEC_INH_INHIBICION`. Figures come from the data; **the theoretical framework, interpretation and team review are missing**. Spanish name: *Inhibición*. [Spanish version](https://abarejo.github.io/leeduca-manual/fichas/auto/F_EJEC_INH_INHIBICION.html). ::: **In one sentence.** Inhibition, from age 4 to 7 (3,738 administrations in 4 cohorts). Stability across time points ρ = .05. AUC .39–.54 against persistent reading difficulty. ## Description | | | |---|---| | Codes | 1863 | | Battery | UNED | | Format | rapid naming of a series | | Items | — (1863) according to the platform | | Task family | E · Decision with response time | | Score | Correct responses | | Instructions (platform) | A group of numbers is shown on the screen. In the center there is a number in black that could be one, two, three or four times repeated. On each side of this number there is a number in grey. One of the gray numbers corresponds with the number of times the central (black) number is repeated. The child clicks the mouse button (right or left) situated on the same side that the number pointing the times the central number is repeated. In the example above, the right mouse button should be clicked. | ![Example of the screen format (2018 screenshot; not necessarily an item from this task).](../../figuras/pantallas/formato_ran.png){width=45%} ## How it is programmed on the platform The platform is the reference: what the activity actually presents is what is measured. Configuration read from the activity itself on 23/10/2026 (without modifying it). Cell contents are in Spanish. | Code|Name on the platform |Presentation | Test items| Practice items|Example items |Time limit |Order |Scoring | Age.term (label 3)| |----:|:--------------------|:-------------------------|----------:|--------------:|:-------------|:----------|:-----|:----------|------------------:| | 1863|Inhibición |Evaluador marca cada paso | | 4|— |— |fijo |Eficiencia | 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9| **Differences from the dictionary or the instructions (in Spanish):** - **1863.** Tarea CANUM (UNED), 4 de práctica: no es una tarea de inhibición clásica. Internal consistency in the 2021 analyses: α = .98. | Cohort| From| To| n| r| ρ| |------:|----:|---:|---:|-----:|----:| | 2010| 5.3| 7.3| 348| 0.08| 0.05| | 2011| 4.3| 6.2| 593| -0.04| 0.05| ## Validity **Concurrent.** Outside its domain, the highest relation is with: Phonological awareness (4.2, r = .21); Letter knowledge (4.3, r = .00); Letter knowledge (5.2, r = .04); Rapid naming (RAN) (5.3, r = -.07); Word and text reading (6.2, r = .02); Reading comprehension (7.3, r = -.07). **Against reading difficulty and comprehension.** Against persistent difficulty, AUC .39–.54. Against poor comprehension one or two school years later (non-circular criterion), AUC .46–.51. ![Validity: AUC with 95% confidence interval (labels in Spanish).](../../figuras/Ficha_auto_F_EJEC_INH_INHIBICION_F2_validez.png){width=85%} **Against an external criterion, years later.** Against low Woodcock-Muñoz reading fluency in 2021/22 ([chapter](https://abarejo.github.io/leeduca-manual/criterio-woodcock.html), *in Spanish*), AUC .41–.63 (5 time points; 117–256 children). ## Provisional norms | Time point| N| Cohorts| P5| P10| P16| P25| P50| P75| P90| |----------:|---:|-------:|----:|----:|---:|---:|---:|---:|-----:| | 4.2| 560| 2013| 16.0| 34.0| 61| 84| 91| 121| 121.0| | 4.3| 795| 2011| 34.0| 63.4| 74| 86| 90| 92| 94.0| | 5.2| 322| 2012| 56.0| 59.0| 61| 63| 89| 92| 98.9| | 5.3| 252| 2010| 62.6| 72.1| 84| 88| 90| 92| 93.0| | 6.2| 768| 2011| 45.4| 58.7| 62| 68| 91| 96| 121.0| | 7.3| 165| 2010| 30.0| 31.0| 50| 61| 90| 93| 121.0| These are norms by time point (school year × term). For dates between assessments and time points without a normative sample, study M3 proposes continuous norms on **months of instruction**, not on age, with relative age within the school year as an adjustment. ![Provisional norms (non-Preleo schools; labels in Spanish).](../../figuras/Ficha_auto_F_EJEC_INH_INHIBICION_F1_baremo.png){width=85%} ## Variables that affect it |Variable | Time point| n| Effect| p| |:---------------------------------------|----------:|---:|------:|-----:| |School SES (ρ) | 4.2| 568| 0.001| 0.976| |Sex (d girl − boy; coding under review) | 4.2| 565| -0.082| 0.328| |Relative age (ρ with age in months) | 4.2| 568| -0.042| 0.320| |School (ICC) | 4.2| 568| 0.578| | |School SES (ρ) | 4.3| 795| -0.064| 0.070| |Sex (d girl − boy; coding under review) | 4.3| 769| 0.105| 0.147| |Relative age (ρ with age in months) | 4.3| 764| -0.031| 0.396| |School (ICC) | 4.3| 795| 0.472| | |School SES (ρ) | 5.2| 299| -0.021| 0.722| |Sex (d girl − boy; coding under review) | 5.2| 323| -0.004| 0.974| |Relative age (ρ with age in months) | 5.2| 319| 0.013| 0.822| |School (ICC) | 5.2| 325| 0.595| | |School SES (ρ) | 5.3| 855| -0.210| 0.000| |Sex (d girl − boy; coding under review) | 5.3| 817| 0.083| 0.236| |Relative age (ρ with age in months) | 5.3| 816| -0.023| 0.515| |School (ICC) | 5.3| 855| 0.562| | |School SES (ρ) | 6.2| 730| 0.113| 0.002| |Sex (d girl − boy; coding under review) | 6.2| 767| -0.084| 0.246| |Relative age (ρ with age in months) | 6.2| 765| 0.051| 0.162| |School (ICC) | 6.2| 768| 0.228| | |School SES (ρ) | 7.3| 427| -0.213| 0.000| |Sex (d girl − boy; coding under review) | 7.3| 424| 0.076| 0.439| |Relative age (ρ with age in months) | 7.3| 424| -0.028| 0.560| |School (ICC) | 7.3| 427| 0.231| | ## For publications The LEEDUCA platform task “Inhibition” (code 1863; UNED battery) assesses inhibitory control. The child names a series of familiar stimuli on the screen as quickly as possible, and the examiner records correct responses and errors. It comprises 121 items. The time limit is 300 seconds. It is administered individually on a computer at school. In the 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2013 cohorts it was administered in 6 sessions, from 4 to 7 years of age. The main outcome is the number of correct responses. In our data (2021 analyses), internal consistency was α = .98 (N = 2,501, 121 items). Stability across time points was ρ = .05. Against later poor reading comprehension, AUC = .46–.51. ## Pending issues - Ceiling effect at 4.2, 7.3 (more than 15% of children with the maximum score). - Write the interpretation; review with the team.
